subject: [PATCH v5 02/19] selftests/mm: skip collapse_compound_extreme() where the PMD is too large

2026-09-08.patch_summary: This patch modifies the selftests/mm/khugepaged.c test to skip a specific test case where the PMD (Page Map Directory) size is too large, causing the allocator to fail reliably handing out allocations. The test case in question, collapse_compound_extreme(), requires multiple consecutive PMD-order allocations, which becomes unmanageable with larger PMDs. By skipping this test case for PMDs larger than 32M, the patch ensures that the test suite does not fail abruptly and allows other cases to run successfully.
